# Doc Toolkit
## Extract text
Use `pdfplumber` to open the file and read `page.extract_text()` for each page.
## Fill forms
Use `pypdf` to read form fields and write values the user provides. A printable copy of this guide is in `GUIDE.pdf`; it repeats these steps.
